title: MCP Tool Poisoning in Agentic AI Frameworks: A Cross-Framework Measurement Study
topic_zh: 基准、数据集与评测方法
tags_zh: 实证研究 · 评测 · 开源工件 · 真实披露
tags_en: empirical study / survey · evaluation · open artifacts · real disclosure / maintainer-confirmed
judgment_zh: 加分：首个带真实执行确认的跨框架 MCP 工具投毒实测（12 框架×18 模型×45 场景共 9720 格 susceptibility matrix）；提出 25 类根因分类法、canary 回执双重预言机并使用卡方统计；开源工具 mcpvenom；完成 5 次跨 4 厂商协同披露并做 12 框架代码级审计。扣分：本质为提示注入类攻击面的测量研究，与代码审计主线相关性偏弱；现有缓解（正则描述扫描 7.2% 误报）仅部分有效；5 次披露均被厂商拒绝，缺乏真实生态修复反馈
judgment_en: Bonus: first cross-framework measurement of MCP tool poisoning with real tool execution (a 9,720-cell susceptibility matrix over 12 frameworks, 18 models, and 45 attack scenarios); contributes a 25-class root-cause taxonomy, a dual canary-receipt oracle, and chi-squared statistics; open-source tool mcpvenom; five coordinated disclosures across four vendors plus a code-level audit of all twelve frameworks. Deduction: essentially a measurement study of a prompt-injection-type attack surface, loosely tied to the code-auditing focus; the examined mitigation (a regex description scanner with a 7.2% false-positive rate) is only partial; all five disclosures were rejected by vendors, so no real-ecosystem remediation feedback

Deduction: belongs to agent-toolchain protection and is only weakly related to the mainline of AI-based code auditing; limited practical argument for isolation assumptions such as copy confinement and a data-free germline; no explicit statement of open artifacts
